nodes.question: Why is rainfed production significant in this study?
nodes.answer: Rainfed production constitutes approximately two-thirds (62%) of Indian cereal area and is more susceptible to climate variability.

nodes.question: How do transcription factors contribute to plant growth?
nodes.answer: Transcription factors are critical regulators in diverse signaling networks that enhance plant growth and development, especially under stress situations.
nodes.paragraph: Protein electrophoresis is a practi - cal biochemical technique and reliable method to detect biochemical markers in many crops. It has been used to provide a relatively convenient and rapid method of iden - tification and classification of gene bank collections and to distinguish between maize genotypes [20, 21]. On the other hand, electrophoresis techniques provide a unique method to study protein substructure differences among genotypes and treatments, enabling the study of hybrids and lines [22]. Gene expression analysis is one of the most significant methods for understanding the complex signaling net - works that control the many responses observed during the plant life cycle or when exposed to diverse stimuli [23]. Real-Time quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR) stands out from other gene expression methodologies due to its accuracy, sensitivity, and speed. As a result, the method has emerged as the gold standard for medium-through - put gene expression analysis [24]. Transcription factors emerged as critical regulators in diverse signaling net - works, playing a crucial role in enhancing plant growth and development under stress situations [25].

nodes.question: What is the significance of the multicriteria climatic classification system for grape-growing regions worldwide?
nodes.answer: The multicriteria climatic classification system helps in identifying the suitability of different regions for grape cultivation based on various climatic factors.

nodes.question: What factors, besides yields, are important for crop production stability?
nodes.answer: Changes in harvested area associated with climate variability are important factors for crop production stability.
nodes.paragraph: 14,15). However, by attri- buting production volatility solely to yields, other important factorsmay be ignored that also in uence production stability.
